name: questline
description: Path of Dev: an RPG around your Claude Code work: XP, levels, loot and a pixel pet, drawn in a band above the prompt.

minWords.title: Words to grade a prompt
minWords.description: A prompt you type earns XP from Haiku's grade once it has this many words, pasted text included. Shorter ones, slash commands and prompts you didn't type go ungraded. Only the scores leave your machine, never the prompt.

animations.title: Celebrations
animations.description: How loot drops, level-ups and finished missions play in the band: full animations (the band grows for the big ones, epic and legendary chime), reduced (one still frame in the band's own rows, no sound), or off.

toasts.title: Reward toasts
toasts.description: One toast for everything a prompt, a commit, a mission or a level-up earned: the mission, its XP, level-ups, drops and gold. Off, the band still celebrates and names the latest gain.

server.title: Server
server.description: Which local server the mod plays on: your own save (default), or the dev sandbox in ~/.pathofdev-dev for trying out band styles, XP and celebrations (start it with PATHOFDEV_DEV=1 pnpm --filter @pathofdev/server start). PATHOFDEV_HOME, when set, picks the home for either.
